Transparency

Privacy and data.

The initial version is a static website with no accounts, newsletter or third-party advertising.

Information we collect

The site itself does not ask visitors to create accounts and does not collect personal data through forms. Hosting providers may process network request logs for security and delivery according to their policies.

Cookies

The initial static website does not set tracking or advertising cookies. If analytics are added later, this policy will be updated.

External links

Some articles link to official club sources. Their sites have their own privacy policies.
